purpose: development-only fixed approximate earliest-signal gate on frozen 5 Hz receiver predictions
maximum_speed_rule: maximum of registered 401x401x94 velocity array; not selected using waveform results
gate_formula: tau0 = ts - 0.20 + max(||receiver-source||-200, 0)/vmax; s=clip((t-tau0)/0.10,0,1); gate=6s^5-15s^4+10s^3; corrected=unmodified_waveform*gate
data_role: same twelve already-inspected +/-80/160/280 m depth development observations; two trained anchors for finite responses; no new confirmation or retraining
measurements: raw true-source full-record relative L2 before/after; fraction of FD observed energy removed; false pre-origin threshold picks before/after; count matched picks; finite depth-response L2 and cosine before/after
evaluation_rule: no time shift, gain or source refitting; evaluate all twelve regardless of outcome; if FD energy removed is appreciable, flag physical mismatch; improvements in picker alone are insufficient
limitations: The Ricker pulse and Gaussian source have tails, so this is an approximate earliest-signal taper, not exact causality or a physics-constrained trained operator. A postprocessing audit is not independent validation.
